title: Unit equation for normalized derived scalar association
statement: Given normalized source and target scalar presentations, ordinary restriction with its generator normalization, and a derived scalar-association isomorphism normalized by kappa, the composite of derived restriction and underlying scalar association carries the source scalar unit to the target scalar unit, for every unbounded derived object.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 0G7E and 06YU; scalar-unit refinement with sites-modules.tex Tag 03EL; parent proof steps 1–6.

proof.text: The normalized units and ordinary generator unit square compute the adjunction mate on resolving objects. Only the unit formulas at the resolving complex and its exact pullback are required.

Conjugate each cochain counit by the fixed ordinary model identification. The prescribed extension formula equals the mate computation. Since the target counit computes on the pulled-back resolving complex, cancel it and show that mate followed by the extension is identity.
Full faithfulness on resolving objects gives equality on the derived category. The defining mate unit equation and cancellation now give the asserted scalar unit equation.

proof_origin.place: Explicit formalization of the parent scalar/unit refinement of Tags 07A4 and 0G7E.
